text: Credential CRD_000057 for Dr. Rebecca Hanson was issued in the UAE, while her 12 claims sit entirely in India and Turkey. Cross-jurisdiction practice on its own is legal and common here, so the alert is low severity. Two treatment countries is within the honest range; three or more never occurs honestly in this data and would escalate. Ordinary corridor practice is the likely explanation. Next step: only if corroborated elsewhere — check whether the UAE issuance is recognised where the claims occurred.
